answer: Each identity must plant one velvet flag on a distinct summit route through karst, and stake a rope bond for it. The k-th flag from one operator costs k squared in rope, because the warden re-climbs every earlier pitch before approving the next, so N fakes cost N(N+1)(2N+1)/6: 385 for 10, 338,350 for 100. Two flags on one route void both identities at the close.
